prompt: A hyper-realistic, cinematic wide shot of a massive bipedal rescue robot climbing a steep, rugged mountain cliff face. The robot is constructed from heavy-duty industrial machinery parts, featuring white and black segmented armor plating with visible hydraulic pistons and mechanical joints. On the chest and shoulder plates, there are clear markings reading "警視庁" (Metropolitan Police Department) and "MPD" in bold white text. Two red warning lights glow on its shoulders. Instead of a human head, the robot has a sensor array resembling a camera lens cluster mounted on a neck-like structure. Surrounding the robot are four large quadcopter drones hovering in the air, some emitting water spray or signals. In the background, far below, a winding road through a lush green valley is visible, along with emergency vehicles and a blue command tent, indicating an active rescue operation site. The lighting is bright daylight with sharp shadows, emphasizing the metallic texture and the scale of the machine against the natural landscape.
